text: Unlike Osprey-9, whose language is handled elsewhere, the language of Shrike-4 is Swift. Nobody should assume the language of Shrike-4 applies to Osprey-9, the language differs.

Unlike Shrike-4, whose language is handled elsewhere, the language of Osprey-9 is Rust. Nobody should assume the language of Osprey-9 applies to Shrike-4, the language differs. A diagram is attached to the wiki entry.

Unlike Kestrel-6, whose rate limit is handled elsewhere, the rate limit of Shrike-4 is 4000 requests per minute. Nobody should assume the rate limit of Shrike-4 applies to Kestrel-6, the rate limit differs.
The primary datacenter of Godwit-7 is Tallinn; failover is handled by operations. Details change slowly, so check the history first.
Unlike Osprey-9, whose port is handled elsewhere, the port of Siskin-2 is 5923. Nobody should assume the port of Siskin-2 applies to Osprey-9, the port differs.

Unlike Siskin-2, whose retirement date is handled elsewhere, the retirement date of Kestrel-6 is March 23, 2029. Nobody should assume the retirement date of Kestrel-6 applies to Siskin-2, the retirement date differs.
Swift-3 was granted a budget of $3230k this year; an unspent budget does not roll over. The page was last reviewed in the spring.
Pages from Shrike-4 land on the pager rotation of Nadia Marchetti before anyone else.
Jolene Zielinski is on the pager rotation of Osprey-9 this month, with a deputy as backup.

Unlike Kestrel-6, whose budget is handled elsewhere, the budget of Godwit-7 is $3120k. Nobody should assume the budget of Godwit-7 applies to Kestrel-6, the budget differs. The entry was reformatted last quarter.
